title: education cycle
message:
Hey 👋

Just sharing a real thought about the current situation of the Indian education system 🇮🇳—something almost every student and family can relate to.

Right now, the journey looks something like this:

A 10th pass student is stressed about choosing the “right” stream and finding a good science college 😓. Everyone says science = success, so many students follow the crowd instead of their interest.

Then comes 12th…
Science students start running after the “best” colleges 🏫—preparing for exams like JEE Main and NEET. Coaching classes, pressure, competition… it becomes a race more than learning.

After getting into college 🎓, a new tension begins: placements.
College students are now chasing the “best job” 💼—good salary, big company, stable life. Skills sometimes come second, marks and degrees come first.

Once someone gets a job, society brings the next expectation…
Now it’s about finding the “perfect life partner” ❤️. Stability, salary, status—all become factors.

Then after marriage, the cycle continues…
Parents start worrying about their children 👶—their future, their education, their success.

And finally…
Those children grow up and the same question comes again:
“Which is the best school?” 🏫

And the loop repeats 🔁

👉 This shows one important thing:
We are stuck in a continuous cycle of pressure, comparison, and expectations.

But here’s something to think about 🤔

* Are we choosing based on passion or pressure?
* Is “best” really the same for everyone?
* Are we learning, or just competing?

✨ Reality check:
Success doesn’t come from just choosing science, a top college, or a high-paying job. It comes from skills, interest, consistency, and mental peace.

📌 Small advice:

* Choose what you like, not what others force
* Focus on skills, not just marks
* Don’t compare your journey with others
* Every path (science, commerce, arts, skills) has value

India’s education system is improving, but mindset matters more than system.

Let’s try to break the cycle and choose wisely 🙌
